root_cause: Auxiliary workflows directly listed generic delivery policy/classifier files in pull_request path triggers. Delivery-control-plane changes therefore started SEO growth, Fresh Device Canary and Powerhouse Assurance even when their owned domain surfaces were untouched.
prevention_rule: Auxiliary workflows must trigger from their owned domain inputs and their own workflow definition, not from generic delivery policy/classifier roots. Delivery classifier changes are validated by canonical Required regressions. Auxiliary workflow files themselves receive explicit owned lane classification.
